notes.title: More Bug Fixes AND CHECKPOINTS ADDED!
notes.notes: [p]Added a few things, had to rush this update since there was a problem with loading object textures and it needed to be fixed so I have done that, I have also:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Made loading in to the playtest faster,[/p][/*][*][p]Added checkpoints to the practice mode (and playtest)[/p][/*][*][p]descriptions properly update now[/p][/*][*][p]respawning after death fixed (player spawns as the screen un-fades.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Join the discord to see more announcements and have your levels showcased at some point will be working on more updates as time goes by: [url="https://discord.gg/fSt6Buxgrs"]https://discord.gg/fSt6Buxgrs[/url][/p]

notes.title: Minor Early Update Patches
notes.notes:
[p]Just a few patches to the new level editor:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issues with duplicating any objects.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now place objects closer to each other.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some convenience bugs in the editor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual bugs when completing a level in practice mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual confirmation of updating descriptions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I will be posting more updates and changes here and on my discord server, there you can also let me know about any bugs you may find and possibly earn special roles and show off some levels!

JOIN THE SERVER! > [url="https://discord.gg/fSt6Buxgrs"]https://discord.gg/fSt6Buxgrs[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Hope everyone is enjoying the update![/p]

notes.notes: small update to increase the player jump power very slightly. Should make some of the very difficult jumps slightly better to attempt.

notes.title: OFFICIAL GAME RELEASE!

I would love to hear what everyone thinks.[/p]
